description: Poll for what changed since a date instead of re-pulling everything: newly certified records, superseded (old->new) pairs, and reconfirmed records. Example: {"since":"2026-10-01","collection":"ok_property_permits"} returns permits certified after that date (new weekly Oklahoma City reroofing permits). Sources are re-checked weekly (Sundays, 00:00 UTC). Omitting `collection` scopes to ok_roofing_insurance only. Free, no API key.

city.description: ok_property_permits only: "Norman" or "Oklahoma City" (alias jurisdiction_city accepted).

collection.description: Which collection to poll; default ok_roofing_insurance.

subject.description: Exact category, same values as search_records.

topic.description: Exact topic / permit type, same values as search_records.

name: list_changes_since
